args.question:

- INV-87832: $2,602.73, due 2026-11-04
- INV-63193: $4,766.38, due 2026-11-25
(There is also INV-89428 for $6,318.88, but it is in draft status awaiting approval, so I have not touched it. INV-47737 is already paid.)
